findings.current: Someone did shoot an arrow at me. I just don’t think it was an attack.
findings.defect: The source repeats “attack” to preserve the paradox: it was an attack, but apparently not an attack. Replacing the first instance with a factual explanation removes that joke logic and loses a detail retained in the accepted baseline.
findings.rationale: The Korean says “습격은 습격인데, 습격이 아니었던 것 같습니다.” The arrow explanation comes later; it is not part of this line.
findings.replacement: It was an attack, but I don’t think it was an attack.

findings.current: He had smashed apart that sturdy table with one blow.
findings.defect: “With one blow” specifies a number of strikes that the Korean does not establish.
findings.rationale: The source says he smashed the sturdy table by striking it, without specifying that it took one blow.
findings.replacement: He had smashed that sturdy table apart.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, but one line resolves a deliberate contradiction in the source, and another adds an unstated number of blows.
